label: Icon Capsule
title: Icon Capsule
summary: Use an Icon Capsule to show one icon in a coloured circle, such as the mark at the start of a list row or a status on a result screen.
corePrinciple: One glyph in one circle; modes pick its size and colour.

anatomy.title: An icon in a circle
anatomy.description: The circle and the icon inside it both come from modes. There’s no text: the words belong to the row or tile around it.
blocks: Icon Capsule Size sets it, 42 px at M; AppearanceBrand and Emphasis fill it.
iconName: one glyph from the Coin icon set, 18 px at M.

anatomy.note: Icon Capsule Size sets it, 42 px at M; AppearanceBrand and Emphasis fill it.
iconName: one glyph from the Coin icon set, 18 px at M.

configuration.title: Colour from three modes
configuration.description: With Semantic Intent Brand, the default, AppearanceBrand picks the colour and Emphasis how strong it is. Semantic Intent System colours it with AppearanceSystem instead, for success, warning, and errors, and ignores Emphasis. With no modes it’s Primary gold; Figma draws Neutral.

states.title: No states of its own
states.description: An Icon Capsule doesn’t press, select, or disable: the row or tile around it does. If iconName isn’t in the Coin icon set, the circle shows with nothing in it.
blocks: An unknown name leaves the circle empty.

examples.title: Not in the icon set
examples.description: An unknown name leaves the circle empty.

sizing.title: Four sizes
sizing.description: Icon Capsule Size sets the circle and the icon together: XS is 18 px with a 12 px icon, S 29 with 18, M 42 with 18, and L 81 with 36. Figma draws M. Some parent components set the Context mode instead, which fixes the capsule at 14 or 58 px whatever its size.

content.title: One glyph that names the thing
content.description: Pick the glyph from the Coin icon set by its iconName, so it says the same as the row’s title: a bulb for electricity, a drop for water. A capsule holds one glyph, never letters or a logo; use an Avatar for those.

inContext.title: The mark at the start of a row
inContext.description: In a List Item’s leading slot the capsule says what each row is about. The row passes its modes to the capsule, and the capsule’s own modes win, so set its colour on the capsule.

doDont.title: Keep the icon and its meaning
doDont.description: Each pair shows a capsule people read at a glance next to one that loses its icon or says the wrong thing.

sources.title: Use the public Icon Capsule contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 (27 October build of Biscuit’s main) from the team’s private package repository. Figma’s Icon Capsule has a Type property, Default or Glass, and an icon swap, drawn at 42 px in Neutral. The package takes iconName and modes: it has no Glass type, and with no modes it’s Primary gold. It drops accessibilityLabel and hides the icon from screen readers, so name it in the row or tile around it. A custom source icon shows only when iconName isn’t in the icon set (reported).
